# Stargate Data Center Gets Power Boost With Natural Gas Plant in Texas (Business Insider, 2025-01-27)

By Ellen Thomas. "The developers of the first Project Stargate data center in Abilene, Texas, plan to build a natural gas plant on the site, according to public filings reviewed by Business Insider."

## Key findings
- The first Project Stargate data center (Abilene, TX) will have an **on-site natural gas plant**.
- Once operational, the plant could produce up to **360.5 megawatts** of power at any given time, up to 24 hours a day.
- Based on **public filings** (TCEQ / regulatory) reviewed by Business Insider.

## Assessment
- `authoritative: yes` — Business Insider (top-tier outlet) reporting on public regulatory filings.
- Confirms **fossil-fuel (natural gas) proximity**: a 360.5 MW on-site natural gas plant at the Abilene Stargate campus.
- Corroborated by the Hedges fact sheet (source 172), which names GE Vernova gas turbines as backup power at Abilene.
